transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I just can't seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. 

I work in a warehouse, and lately, every little thing catches my attention. Like, a beeper will go off, or I'll hear a forklift alarm, or someone is just moving a pallet nearby... and it completely pulls me off my count. Then I look down and realize I've gone and put the wrong numbers into the inventory system. It's just getting to be a real problem at work.
Do you find that you have a hard time staying still, such as needing to constantly tap your feet or fidget while sitting?

Yeah, I really do. It's like I can't just relax anymore. Even after my shifts, instead of being worn out like usual, I come home just... buzzing. I end up reorganizing the kitchen cabinets or going out and sorting bins in the garage, mostly because just sitting down on the couch feels impossible right now.
Looking back at your childhood, say when you were in elementary school, did you experience these same difficulties with staying focused or sitting still?

No, I... I don't think so. Looking back, I was always pretty good about paying attention in class. I never got in trouble for fidgeting or anything like that when I was a kid. This whole feeling of being so wound up and distracted, it's... well, it's really just a recent thing for me. I definitely wasn't like this growing up.
Have you recently started using any new medications, supplements, or substances, or have you recently stopped using something you were previously taking regularly?
No, I haven't started anything new. I don't really take any supplements or anything like that. And I haven't stopped taking anything either. Everything's just been the same as usual on that front.
Do you find that you feel this way specifically when you have gone for a while without having a drink?

No, it's not tied to that at all. I mean, I hardly ever drink anyway, maybe a beer at a barbecue once in a blue moon. So, no, it's definitely not about going without a drink. I feel this way regardless.

Do you find that you have been experiencing excessive worry or apprehension about a variety of different things, like your work performance, your health, or your finances, on most days for the past few months?

No, not really. I mean, I worry about normal things sometimes, like anyone else, but it's not excessive. It's definitely not something I think about every day or anything like that. My mind is just... racing with other things, not really worrying about work or bills.

During this time that you have been feeling so 'wound up' and energetic, would you say your mood has been unusually high, euphoric, or irritable, or have you actually been feeling quite down or depressed?

Well, I wouldn't say I've been feeling down at all. It's more like... some days I feel almost too upbeat. Like I have so much energy I could fix up the whole house and reorganize the warehouse at work all before dinner. But then, on the flip side, if my husband questions one of my plans or gets in the way, I just... I snap at him over something really small. So it's a mix of feeling really high and then getting really irritable.
How many days in a row has this period of feeling unusually high, energetic, or irritable lasted so far?

It's been going on for about a month now. It started right around the time my husband stopped working outside the house. Our whole usual routine just changed, and that's when this all really kicked off. So, yeah, it's been a solid month of feeling this way every day.
Have you ever experienced a period like this in your life before, where you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable for several days or longer?

No, I really haven't. I mean... I've had good days and bad days, of course, but nothing like this. This kind of... constant energy and feeling so on edge all the time, for a whole month? No, this is definitely the first time I've ever felt quite like this.
During this past month when you have been feeling so energetic and wound up, have you noticed that you need much less sleep than you usually do to feel rested?

No, not really. I mean, my sleep hasn't really changed. I still go to bed around the same time and wake up when I usually do. I haven't noticed needing less sleep to feel rested or anything like that. I'm just... really energized during the day.
During this past month, have you felt like you were unusually talented, powerful, or had special abilities that others don't have?

No, definitely not. I don't feel like I have any special powers or anything like that. I'm just... you know, a regular person. I just have a lot more energy and feel kind of wound up, but I don't think I'm unusually talented or better than anyone else.
Have you noticed any new physical symptoms or health concerns, such as changes in your appetite, weight, body temperature, or heart rate, since this period of high energy started?

No, I haven't really noticed any of that. Um, my appetite is pretty much the same as always, and I haven't gained or lost any weight that I can tell. And physically... no, I feel fine. My heart isn't racing or anything, and I haven't felt unusually hot or cold. It's really just the energy level that's different, but nothing physical like what you're asking about.
Have you noticed any changes in your memory, your ability to find the right words when you speak, or any recent headaches or vision problems?

No, I haven't had any of those issues. My memory seems fine, and I haven't had any trouble finding words or anything. And no headaches or vision changes either. Everything like that is completely normal.
Have you had any recent blood work or a physical check-up with your primary care doctor since these symptoms started?

No, I haven't. I haven't been to see my regular doctor lately. So, no recent blood work or physicals or anything like that since all this extra energy started. I just didn't really think to go in, since physically I feel fine.
Have you noticed any new, unexplained physical symptoms like tremors in your hands or feeling like your heart is beating faster or harder than usual?

No, um, like I mentioned a minute ago about my heart, it feels completely normal. It's not beating fast or pounding or anything. And my hands are perfectly steady, so no tremors or shaking. I really haven't had any new physical issues come up at all.
During this past month, or perhaps even before it started, have you experienced any periods where you felt persistently sad, hopeless, or lost interest in the things you usually enjoy?

No, I haven't really felt sad or hopeless. Honestly, I've just had all this extra energy lately. I haven't lost interest in anything, either. I've actually been getting a lot done. So, no, no periods of feeling down or anything like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your personality or the way you interact with others, such as becoming more impulsive or having trouble with your judgment, since this all started?

I guess I have been a little impulsive with money. I've spent way more than I should have at these craft markets lately. I bought all sorts of paints, frames, and tools for projects that I was just sure would turn into something useful. But... well, looking at the credit card bill now, I'm honestly pretty embarrassed. So yeah, my judgment was definitely a bit off there.
Have you noticed any unexplained changes in your skin, such as it becoming thinner, or have you noticed your hair becoming more brittle or falling out more than usual?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My skin seems normal, and my hair isn't falling out or feeling brittle. Everything physical has just been pretty much the same as always.
Have you noticed any unexplained changes in your bowel habits, such as frequent diarrhea or constipation, since this all started?
No, nothing like that. My stomach's been totally fine. I haven't had any issues with diarrhea or constipation, or anything else really. Just the usual.
Have you noticed any increased sensitivity to heat, or have you been sweating more than usual lately?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't feel like I'm any more sensitive to heat than usual, and I haven't been sweating more either. It's just been normal in that regard.
